name: SOS Voz Amiga (Portugal)
summary: Emotional support helpline for anyone in Portugal experiencing distress.
description: SOS Voz Amiga provides free, confidential emotional support by phone for anyone in Portugal experiencing emotional distress, loneliness, or crisis.

sections.title: About SOS Voz Amiga
sections.text: SOS Voz Amiga is a Portuguese nonprofit organization that provides free, confidential emotional support to anyone experiencing distress. Operating since 1978, the organization is staffed by trained volunteers who offer a compassionate listening ear to people dealing with loneliness, depression, anxiety, suicidal thoughts, and other emotional challenges. The organization is part of the international Befrienders network and has helped thousands of Portuguese residents find hope and support.

sections.title: Phone Support
sections.text: SOS Voz Amiga's helpline at 213 544 545 connects callers with trained volunteers who provide non-judgmental emotional support. The service is available during scheduled hours—check the website for current availability. Calls are confidential, and callers can remain anonymous.

sections.title: Who Can Use the Service
sections.text: Anyone in Portugal can call SOS Voz Amiga. The service welcomes calls from people experiencing any form of emotional distress, including depression, anxiety, loneliness, relationship problems, grief, work stress, or thoughts of suicide.

sections.title: How to Get Support
sections.text: Call 213 544 545 during operating hours to speak with a trained volunteer. The service is free and confidential. Visit sosvozamiga.org for additional resources and information about getting help. For immediate life-threatening emergencies, contact Portuguese emergency services at 112.
